summary: Installed-repo verification is now reproducible end to end in a fresh target repo through the public consumer scripts, with regression coverage for polluted environment leakage and scaffold/live-proof completeness.
why_next: Prove the installed package surface reaches authoritative status and workflow proof without leaking package-repo state.
residual_risk: Long-horizon replay and multi-step degradation scoring remain outside this slice and still need the dedicated eval-layer task.
Idle workflow behavior and docs/runtime drift automation remain separate follow-on slices.
